sanskrit_verse:
राजा कार्याणि संपश्येत् सद्भिरेव त्रिभिर्वृतः ।
सभामेव प्रविश्याग्र्यामासीनः स्थित एव वा ॥२७॥
transliteration: rājā kāryāṇi saṃpaśyet sadbhireva tribhirvṛtaḥ | sabhāmeva praviśyāgryām āsīnaḥ sthita eva vā ||27||
sph_interpretive_translation: The King shall deliberate upon matters of governance exclusively in the company of the three noble advisors, entering the foremost assembly either seated or standing.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through divinely guided counsel
Causation arises from purified collective intelligence
Capacity-based responsibility requires alignment with enlightened advisors
Restoration logic depends on conscious deliberation within sacred governance space
Consciousness alignment occurs through structured, witnessed decision-making
executable_legal_axioms: IF decision_context != sabhā THEN validity = false
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, no judicial act shall proceed without a quorum of three qualified and initiated advisors aligned with Sanatana Dharma principles. The Chief Justice must deliberate visibly within the designated court chamber, affirming presence and awareness.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through witnessed deliberation among qualified seers. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests via sequential consultation with enlightened advisors. Responsibility aligns proportionally with conscious participation. No punitive consequence arises; only misalignment from dharma-order necessitates reorientation.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Reassemble with three sadbhus for realignment
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Public reaffirmation of dharmic posture
Capacity Restoration: Re-initiation into advisory council
Integrity Reintegration: Re-entry into sabhā under witnessed stance
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
